subject: Achievements
author: Xandu
body:
They should have added more. It is also worth mentioning that they can also add 0 point achievements. So when they have used all the points they can still keep adding more 0 point ones.

-- The Creator --

subject: 99 Total Achievements
author: ZombieTron
body:
Even if 99 is the total number of Achievements allowed (which I am now lead to believe is the case, check out my gamerscore and you will see that I clearly don't play for achievements!)

Paradise still has 47 achievements that it can use. I really don't see that they will add that many to the Island and cops and robbers packs... but I could be wrong.

I personally would have had more incentive to buy the car packs if they included interesting achievements to play for, I'm not saying the PS3 Trophies with the car packs were particularly interesting, but at least it gave some sense of purpose to buy the car packs.

I still haven't bought any of them yet, and doubt I will, although trying out the Boost Specials in a couple of weeks may make me change my mind!

subject: i agree
author: hood gangstaz
body: i agree yes they could and should still add achievements to the dlc packs in fact they did with the party pack it has two for 50 points i think a few people dont know that yet...........but as far adding 1 per car as is on the ps3 is kinda pointless its better to put those trophies or achievements into the packs instead of the cars that we buy

subject: I would love it
author: Mad Wookiee11
body: I don't know why they wouldn't add more achievements.  It seems like they would motivate people to buy more of the DLC packs, and it would give us something to do between packs.  Personally, I would like it if they made the achievements really hard, so it would take more skill than just buying the car to get them.
